title: NodeGX node trace, format version 1
description: What a node did, in one form whichever implementation did it (phase 107, NSP-002). An ordered stream of stimulus events (set, in, settle) and observation events (value, signal, outcome). Between two settles the observation events are grouped canonically: `value` events sorted by port name, then `signal` events in emission order, then `outcome` events in invocation order; a `value` is recorded only when it changed since the last settle. Every event MAY carry a `subject` (what it happened to): omitted in a one-node trace, a node id in a graph trace, and left open for app-level subjects such as `app:click`. `completed` is never recorded: every `outcome` event implies it. A `failure` outcome carries the implementation's error CODE in `error`, never its message. Values are in the canonical form src/canonical.ts defines (tagged `$num` / `$date` objects for what JSON cannot say, keys sorted).

canonical.description: A canonical value: JSON, plus `{ "$num": tag }` for -0 / NaN / ±Infinity and `{ "$date": iso | null }` for a Date. Key order is not expressible in JSON Schema; the TypeScript validator checks it.

oneOf.description: stimulus: a value written to an input port. `value` absent means undefined was written.
stimulus: the target drained its frame; the observations that follow belong to it.
observation: an output value changed (never undefined — C3).
observation: an outcome-reporting input finished (ERG-001) — `port` is the INPUT that was invoked.
